input.summary: Make the liability cap mutual and agreement-wide, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and applied it to the whole Agreement — as drafted only TrueLink's liability is capped (and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11), leaving Client exposed without limit, which we cannot accept. Our position is a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, with indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap and Client's payment obligations unaffected.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD AND (B) USD 1,000,000, AND NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
